name: crunchy-sheets-backend
description: Cloud Functions backend for Crunchy Sheets — AI CFO for Google Sheets

scripts.deploy:analyze: gcloud functions deploy analyze --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --project crunchy-sheets --region us-central1 --source . --entry-point analyze --timeout=300 --memory=512MB --set-env-vars ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(cat ~/.config/secrets/anthropic-crunchy-sheets-key),SUPABASE_URL=https://diselpdcsgjgetgmixhc.supabase.co,SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY=$(cat ~/.config/secrets/supabase-crunchy-sheets-service-key)
scripts.deploy:auth: gcloud functions deploy auth --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --project crunchy-sheets --region us-central1 --source . --entry-point auth --set-env-vars SUPABASE_URL=https://diselpdcsgjgetgmixhc.supabase.co,SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY=$(cat ~/.config/secrets/supabase-crunchy-sheets-service-key)
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:analyze && npm run deploy:auth
